falsification_conditions.condition: BTC closes the 14-day window at least 12% below the window open, and the close is not at least 8% above the window low.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May 2022 Luna-bottom analog failed. A washout without reversal means this is a breakdown, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was the wrong call.

falsification_conditions.condition: SPX gains at least 5% over the next 14 days, VIX prints a daily close at or below 15, and the blowoff score rises from 37 to at least 65.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime resolved as a risk-on blowoff, not an unresolved bottom. HOLD missed a directional melt-up and the bottom-pattern match is invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: A top-5 USD stablecoin prints below $0.97 for more than 4 consecutive hours on a major venue, BTC perpetual funding on a major exchange prints at or below -0.05% per 8h, and BTC then reclaims its pre-event level before day 14.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A Luna-style capitulation bottom completed and reversed. The pattern resolved bullish, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was falsified by a confirmed long.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
